text:
Entry trade size: either a fixed USD notional per buy clip or a percent of effective cash at signal time. Fixed clips give predictable exposure steps; percent mode scales with account equity. When both modes are enabled, percentage sizing can be floored by a minimum fixed clip so tiny accounts still place viable orders.

Exit trade size: symmetric choice between fixed USD notional translated to coin quantity at the exit reference price, or a percent of the open position to scale out. Partial exits are supported via position sizing rules; full exits occur when exit logic fires with sufficient position.

Minimum notional guard: sub-minimum computed sizes are skipped to avoid exchange rejections — if the user sees skipped orders, suggest raising clip size or percent modestly rather than chasing microscopic fills.
